hero.title: Full-Stack Python Developer
hero.description: A demonstration of modern software engineering, featuring decoupled development (Django/Angular) and an architecture designed for AI collaboration.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: Full-Stack Python Developer with solid experience in building scalable web applications using Django, Django REST Framework, Flask, Angular and React.
about.p2: Computer Engineer graduated from UniCarioca (2025) and pursuing MBA in Software Engineering with AI at FullCycle. Currently working as Full Stack Python/Django Developer at EDS (within INEA - State Environmental Institute).
about.p3: Experience in developing high-performance RESTful APIs, managing PostgreSQL and Oracle databases, and working in agile teams (Scrum). Focus on clean code, software engineering best practices and detailed technical documentation.
about.p4: Continuously seeking to improve my technical skills and contribute to projects that generate real impact, applying knowledge acquired in Python, Django, Angular/React, Docker and modern software architecture.
